content.value_statement: Azure API governance can become scattered across teams and environments. This skill provides .NET SDK workflows for inventory, versions, definitions, deployments, and metadata.
actual_capabilities: Explains package installation and DefaultAzureCredential setup for Azure API Center.
Shows workflows for services, workspaces, APIs, versions, and definitions.
Covers importing and exporting API specifications through API Center definitions.
Models environments and deployments with portal, developer, and runtime URI metadata.
Describes metadata schemas for API ownership and governance fields.
limitations: It does not validate current Azure SDK versions or tenant permissions.
Examples use placeholder names, URLs, and IDs that must be replaced.
It does not execute deployments or verify Azure resource state.
It focuses on API Center, not full API gateway configuration.

use_cases.title: Register APIs in Azure API Center
use_cases.description: Create a guided .NET workflow for adding APIs, versions, definitions, and deployments.

use_cases.title: Define Governance Metadata
use_cases.description: Plan required metadata fields for ownership, cost centers, and data classification.

use_cases.title: Prepare SDK Adoption Notes
use_cases.description: Summarize package setup, authentication, resource hierarchy, and common error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up the SDK
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new .NET project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me how to install Azure.ResourceManager.ApiCenter and create an ArmClient with DefaultAzureCredential for my .NET project.

prompt_templates.title: Create Inventory Objects
prompt_templates.scenario: Build the main API Center resource hierarchy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a .NET workflow that creates an API Center service, workspace, API, and version for my team.

prompt_templates.title: Manage Specifications
prompt_templates.scenario: Import and export an API definition.
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through importing an OpenAPI file into an API definition and exporting it later for review.

prompt_templates.title: Design Governance Rollout
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for production API governance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design metadata schemas, environment records, and deployment links for a production API Center rollout.

output_examples.input: I need a .NET plan to register an Orders API in API Center.
output_examples.output: A step-by-step workflow covering service, workspace, API, version, definition, and production deployment.

output_examples.input: How do I track API ownership and data classification?
output_examples.output: Guidance for metadata schema fields, required assignments, and lifecycle stages for governance.

output_examples.input: I need to import an OpenAPI definition.
output_examples.output: A concise sequence for reading a local spec file, importing it, and verifying export results.

best_practices: Replace sample values with tenant-approved names, URLs, and ownership metadata.
Review Azure role assignments before running management code.
Test API definitions and metadata schemas in non-production first.
anti_patterns: Do not run samples against production without reviewing resource names and permissions.
Do not paste secrets into prompts, source files, or metadata fields.
Do not treat sample URLs as deployment endpoints.

faq.question: Does this skill create Azure resources automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and sample workflows. Users must run any .NET code with their own Azure permissions.

faq.question: Which Azure SDK is covered?
faq.answer: It focuses on Azure.ResourceManager.ApiCenter and Azure.Identity for API Center management.

faq.question: Can it manage API Management gateways?
faq.answer: It references API Management only as a related SDK. The main scope is API Center inventory and governance.

faq.question: Does it include production validation?
faq.answer: No. Validate regions, permissions, names, and policies in your own Azure tenant before deployment.

faq.question: Can it help with OpenAPI definitions?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes importing and exporting API specifications through API Center definitions.

faq.question: What credentials are assumed?
faq.answer: The samples use DefaultAzureCredential, so local, managed identity, or developer credentials must be configured separately.
